curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Stripped of the bail money meant to save his cousin, how far will a former Marine go to challenge a corrupt department on its home turf?
curatedMovie.description: When corrupt small-town police unjustly seize the cash a former Marine needs to bail out his cousin, he takes a stand against local law enforcement in this deliberate crime thriller directed by Jeremy Saulnier.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense and deliberate, this small-town crime drama balances exciting tactical friction with steady emotional weight.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Jeremy Saulnier grounds this high-stakes thriller in measured, simmering suspense as a simple family mission collides with systemic small-town hostility.
